title_upweighted_text: Faculty Review Required: Placement Eligibility List Faculty Review Required: Placement Eligibility List Faculty Review Required: Placement Eligibility List Dear Faculty Members, The Placement Cell has prepared the preliminary eligibility list for the upcoming campus recruitment drive. Call for Faculty Mentors: IUCEE Student Chapter Innovation and Sustainability Competition Call for Faculty Mentors: IUCEE Student Chapter Innovation and Sustainability Competition Call for Faculty Mentors: IUCEE Student Chapter Innovation and Sustainability Competition Dear Faculty Members, Greetings! The IUCEE Student Chapter is inviting project proposals for its innovation and sustainability competition. The initiative aims to encourage interdisciplinary collaboration and support student teams working on practical solutions aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Faculty members are encouraged to mentor interested student teams and guide them in developing clear problem statements, feasible solution approaches, and well-structured project proposals. Teams may include students from different engineering disciplines, and interdisciplinary participation is particularly encouraged. Proposals that demonstrate a strong understanding of the problem and include a working proof of concept may receive preference during shortlisting. Key points for faculty mentors: • Each team may include up to five students and one faculty mentor. • Teams should satisfy the year-of-study and interdisciplinary requirements specified in the competition circular. • Proposed projects should address one or more of the eligible SDG targets listed in the attached annexure. • The proposal should describe the problem, proposed solution, implementation approach, expected impact, and feasibility of developing a demonstrable prototype. • The final submission deadline and selection timeline are provided in the official circular. Faculty members who wish to mentor a team are requested to discuss the scope of the project with the students early and ensure that the proposal is reviewed before submission. Please direct students to the official participation form and attached guidelines for complete details. We look forward to your support in nurturing innovative, responsible, and impactful student projects. Best regards, Faculty In-Charge IUCEE Student Chapter NMIMS MPSTME

Faculty Development Programme on Emerging AI Tools for Teaching and Research Faculty Development Programme on Emerging AI Tools for Teaching and Research Faculty Development Programme on Emerging AI Tools for Teaching and Research Dear Faculty Members, The Faculty Development Cell is pleased to announce a professional development programme focused on the effective use of emerging Artificial Intelligence tools in teaching, learning, and research. The programme will include discussions on responsible AI use in academic settings, AI-assisted preparation of teaching material, research discovery and literature review workflows, evaluation of AI-generated outputs, and considerations relating to academic integrity, privacy, and attribution. The session will also include practical demonstrations and an opportunity for participants to exchange experiences and classroom use cases. Programme details: Date: As mentioned in the attached circular Time: As mentioned in the attached circular Venue/Mode: To be confirmed in the official programme notice Registration: Please refer to the registration instructions circulated by the Faculty Development Cell Interested faculty members are requested to review the attached programme outline and complete the registration process within the stated deadline. Heads of Departments are requested to circulate this announcement among their faculty teams and encourage participation, subject to teaching and examination commitments. Participants are encouraged to bring examples of academic tasks or research workflows for discussion.
